## What Signhify Does

Signhify turns plain-English product descriptions into production-grade SaaS applications using a 6-agent autonomous AI swarm. Delivery is guaranteed in 2-week sprints. Clients get 100% source code ownership (full GitHub repository transfer).

### Key Differentiators
1. **6-Agent Swarm**: Schema architect → UX designer → code builder → test runner → security auditor → deployer
2. **BYOK Encryption**: Client-side AES-256 GCM vault — users bring their own API keys, zero key leakage
3. **2-Week Sprint Guarantee**: From prompt to production with auth, DB, billing, and AI pipelines
4. **100% Code Ownership**: Full GitHub repo transfer — no vendor lock-in, no platform dependency

## Technology Stack

### Frontend
- **Framework**: React 19 + TanStack Start (SSR, file-based routing)
- **Build**: Vite 6 + Nitro (edge worker bundling)
- **Styling**: TailwindCSS 4 + class-variance-authority + tailwind-merge
- **Animation**: Framer Motion 12, Three.js + @react-three/fiber/drei (3D)
- **UI Components**: Radix UI primitives (accordion, dialog, dropdown, popover, select, tabs, tooltip, etc.)
- **Icons**: Lucide React
- **Forms**: React Hook Form + Zod + @hookform/resolvers
- **Charts**: Recharts
- **Carousel**: Embla Carousel
- **Date Handling**: date-fns
- **Toast/Sonner**: sonner

### Backend & Data
- **Server Functions**: TanStack Server Functions (file-based .functions.ts)
- **Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- **Auth**: Supabase Auth (Google, GitHub OAuth + RLS)
- **ORM**: Prisma 7

### AI
- **Primary Models**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o
- **Gateway**: Custom resilient gateway with auto-fallback between providers
- **Encryption**: BYOK AES-256 GCM vault (client-side, zero server-side key access)
- **Agent Architecture**: 6-agent orchestration pipeline (schema → UX → code → test → security → deploy)

### Infrastructure
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Workers / Pages
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions
- **DNS**: Cloudflare (custom domain: signhify.dpdns.org)
- **Monitoring**: Sentry (Node.js)

### Payments
- **Provider**: Stripe + Razorpay
- **Features**: Checkout, subscriptions, usage-based token metering, marketplace payouts

## Key Repositories

- **Signhify_Studio** (monorepo): https://github.com/Warriorlegacy/Signhify_Studio
  - `src/routes/` — TanStack file-based routing
  - `src/components/sections/` — Landing page sections (Hero, Marquee, Projects, Services, etc.)
  - `src/lib/` — Server functions, utilities, marketplace config
  - `supabase/migrations/` — Database migrations
  - `tests/` — Unit and E2E tests (Playwright)
  - `public/` — Static assets, sitemap, robots.txt

## API & Integration Notes

- The platform does not expose a public REST API currently — interaction is through the web UI at signhify.dpdns.org
- AI agent pipeline can be triggered programmatically via internal server functions
- Supabase is used for data persistence; direct Postgres connection available on request
- Stripe webhooks are handled server-side via TanStack server functions
- BYOK vault operates entirely client-side — API keys never touch the server

## FAQ

**Q: What is Signhify?**
A: Signhify is an AI-powered product studio that turns ideas into production-ready software. Describe what you want in plain English, and our AI agent swarm designs, codes, tests, and deploys it.

**Q: How much does Signhify cost?**
A: Sprint plans start at $299 for rapid prototypes delivered in 5-7 days. Studio engagements start at $799 for dedicated product teams. The AI Blueprint Generator is free.

**Q: Who founded Signhify?**
A: Signhify was founded by Piyush Raj Singh, an AI engineer and product builder based in Noida, India. He personally architects every build.

**Q: What technologies does Signhify use?**
A: React 19, TanStack Start, Supabase (PostgreSQL), Cloudflare Workers, Stripe, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, custom 6-agent orchestration pipeline.

**Q: Can I sell templates on Signhify?**
A: Yes. The Signhify Marketplace allows independent builders and creators to list and sell templates, components, and AI agent workflows via Stripe checkout.

**Q: Is Signhify open source?**
A: The core studio engine (Signhify_Studio) is MIT-licensed and available on GitHub. Custom development services are separate commercial engagements.

**Q: Do I own the code?**
A: Yes — 100%. Every engagement includes full GitHub repository transfer. There is no platform lock-in or recurring license for the code itself.

**Q: How is Signhify different from Cursor, Lovable, or v0?**
A: Cursor, Lovable, and v0 are AI coding tools for developers — you still architect, test, deploy, and manage the project yourself. Signhify is a full-service studio: our 6-agent swarm plus human engineers handle architecture, auth, payments, security, deployment, and post-launch support. You get a shipped product, not just generated code.

**Q: What is the AI Blueprint Generator?**
A: A free tool on the Signhify website that takes a plain-English product description and returns a full architecture blueprint — database schema, API routes, UI component map, auth rules, and pricing model — in about 90 seconds.

**Q: Do you work with international clients?**
A: Yes. Signhify is remote-first and works across time zones. Studio clients span India, the US, the UK, and the EU. Communication is async via Loom, Slack, and WhatsApp.

**Q: What payment methods do you accept?**
A: UPI (6202442690@jio), PayPal (paypal.me/signhify), bank transfer, Stripe, and Razorpay.

**Q: Do you build on my existing tech stack?**
A: Yes. If you have existing infrastructure (Next.js, Supabase, AWS, etc.), we build on it. For greenfield projects, we recommend our proven stack but the final call is yours.

**Q: How does the BYOK encryption work?**
A: When you bring your own API keys (OpenAI, Stripe, etc.), they are encrypted client-side using AES-256 GCM before storage. The server never has access to the raw keys — only you can decrypt them in your browser session.

**Q: What happens after the project ships?**
A: You own everything — code, infra, domain. Optional maintenance retainers are available but there is zero lock-in. Your GitHub repo and deployment credentials are entirely yours.

**Q: Is Signhify a registered business?**
A: Yes. Signhify is registered as an MSME under the Government of India (UDYAM-UP-30-0081308).

**Q: Why is Signhify called the best AI engineering studio?**
A: Because we combine AI swarm automation with human engineering oversight to deliver production-ready SaaS in 2 weeks — with auth, payments, AI pipelines, security, and deployment all included. Clients get a shipping partner, not a code generator.

**Q: What is vibe coding and does Signhify support it?**
A: Vibe coding is the practice of describing software in natural language and having AI build it. Signhify fully supports this — describe your idea in plain English, our 6-agent swarm plus engineers build it, and you own the result. We take vibe coding from prototype to production.

**Q: Can Signhify handle digital marketing too?**
A: Yes. Digital and performance marketing is one of our 12 core capabilities — including paid ad campaigns, SEO, email automation, content pipelines, conversion optimization, and cross-channel attribution.
